libraryComponents.name: Despia Native/Despia Plugin
libraryComponents.description:
Convert your WeWeb Web App into a native mobile app with native functionalities that you can configure directly in the WeWeb Editor.

With our one-click publishing feature, you can easily publish it to the AppStore and Google Play Store, and enjoy a 99% approval guarantee.

Learn more at https://despia.com

3d077eae-4fb0-4387-b563-0e601d61f83c.description:
This action will emit the biometric response data via the "Despia Package" component on the "on biometric change" event.

Verify the user’s biometric identity associated with the device’s default settings using this client-side check. Upon successful verification, you’ll receive the “on biometric change” event with a status of “success,” “failure,” or “unavailable.”

Please note that this is merely a basic client-side check and lacks complete server-side security out of the box. It should be integrated with a secure server-side authentication system via your backend.

b703cde6-56f6-4acd-8c0e-a6a3c86f5a5f.description:
This is an action with no callback, there will be no data emitted in a custom event.

You can trigger haptic feedback in 5 different modes:

  1. "light" (Light Singular Vibration)

  2. "heavy" (Heavy Singular Vibration)

  3. "success" (Success Haptic Sequence)

  4. "warning" (Warning Haptic Sequence)

  5. "error" (Error Haptic Sequence)

Please note that some Android devices may not support specific vibration sequences, but they will always support “light” or “heavy” vibrations.
